name: Black Widow (Claire Voyant)

abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.
abilityDetails.Bleed: Zamanla doğrudan fiziksel kanama hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Poison: Zamanla zehir hasarı verir ve iyileşme etkilerini %30 azaltır.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Buff Immunity: Etkilenen şampiyonlar buff'lara bağışıklık kazanır; mevcut buff'lar kaldırılır ve yenileri kazanılamaz.
abilityDetails.Power Steal: Hedefin gücünü azaltıp aynı miktarı kendine kazandırır.

signatureAbility:
Death Immunity
When receiving damage that would knock her out, Death Touch is removed instead and Claire gains a Death Immunity Buff, preventing death and healing [4 - 25]% of her max health over 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Passive
content: Claire uses spells in her Basic Attacks causing them to deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.

abilitySections.title: Clairvoyance Charge - Passive
content: Claire starts with 3 charges. Each time she or her Opponent are immune to any effect, she gains 1 charge and 4% of her max Power. Charges stack up to 20.
After landing or receiving a Light or Medium attack and the Opponent has 1 or more Buffs, a charge is consumed and 1 Buff is Nullified.

abilitySections.title: Curse of the Black Widow
content: Claire has 3 types of curses each providing her with a different immunity, however only 1 curse can be active at a time.
By default the Curse of Blood is active. Landing a fourth Light Attack casts the next curse in the following order.
Curse of Blood: Bleed immunity. Curse of Plague: Poison immunity. Curse of Hellfire: Incinerate immunity.
When entering a new Curse any Bleed, Poison or Incinerate Debuffs that are Purified by the corresponding curse grant 1 Clairvoyance charge and 4% of Claire's max Power.

abilitySections.title: Curse of Damnation
content: Finishing a combo with a Medium attack inflicts 1 Debuff. Throwing a Heavy Attack or Special 1 inflicts up to 3 Debuffs. These Debuffs are determined by Claire's active curse and last for 8 seconds.

Curse of Blood: Bleed, dealing [500.6] direct damage. Curse of Plague: Poison, dealing [500.6] damage and reducing health recovery by 30%. Curse of Hellfire: Incinerate, dealing [500.6] damage, removing Perfect Block Chance and reducing Block Proficiency by 50%.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: 100% chance to inflict the Opponent with Buff Immunity for 10 seconds. Decreasing to 50% against Science Champions.

Each hit grants an effect determined by Claire's active curse. Curse of Blood: Regenerate 35% of the damage dealt. Curse of Plague: Steal 5% of the Opponent's current Power. Curse of Hellfire: Deal a burst of [10,012] Energy Damage.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: All Clairvoyance charges are removed, each increasing her Attack Rating during this attack by [2,503].
Claire gains Death Touch, lasting for 1.2 seconds per Clairvoyance charge removed, Death Touch increases the Potency of all Curse effects by 100% and is not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Death Immunity
content: When receiving damage that would knock her out, Death Touch is removed instead and Claire gains a Death Immunity Buff, preventing death and healing [4 - 25]% of her max health over 4 seconds.
